results.title: Surveying and cartographic aspects of utility networks in Slovakia and Poland

abstracts.content:
Utility networks provide transport for various types of raw materials. They comprise a network
of pipes, cables and ducts running on, under and above the surface of either ground or water.
They connect individual customers with distributors within water supply, sewage, heating, telecommunications, electricity, as well as oil, gas and chemical networks. They serve an extremely
important role in today’s urbanised world. However, utility networks require specialised treatment not only in legal, technical or social terms, but also geodetic and cartographic.
It is necessary to conduct a precise and accurate inventory to prepare and implement projects
of utility networks, as well as all kinds of other construction works. Mapping is another task
required, along with the preparation of databases on networks that provide comprehensive
(graphic and descriptive) information on objects. In each country, the execution of surveying
and cartographic works observes internal laws and technical standards and norms. This paper
presents the issues of surveying and cartographic works in relation to utility networks, as well as
their implementation in Slovakia (Bratislava) and Poland (Kraków). The rules for the presentation of networks on maps, as well as technical standards for collecting, processing and sharing
network databases based on legal provisions that are valid for both countries, were compared.

Fire significantly influences beetle diversity in natural wetland forests but the effects vary by forest type and insect species

abstracts.content: Wildfires are major ecological disturbances, with increasing intensity worldwide. In Central and Northern Europe, research on wildfire impacts on biodiversity has primarily focused on dry and semi-dry coniferous habitats, while the effects of fire in wet and broad-leaved environments remain poorly understood. We investigated the impact of a large wildfire that occurred in 2020 in Biebrza National Park (Poland) on the biodiversity of beetles in wet birch, wet alder, and in dry-mesic oak forests. Beetles were sampled between 2020 and 2022 using purple 12-funnel traps placed in paired burned and unburned forest fragments. The analysis revealed significant differences in beetle communities between burned and unburned sites across all forest types. Indicator species analysis identified 12 beetle species that were associated with burned sites, primarily in oak forest, 15 species that were indicators of unburned sites, mainly in birch and alder forests, and one species whose response was dependent on forest type. Furthermore, we analyzed changes in the abundance of individual indicator species over the three years following the fire and discussed potential factors influencing the observed patterns of abundance dynamics. Our findings demonstrate that fire can have both positive and negative effects on beetle diversity, with the impact varying depending on forest type and insect species. Conservation strategies should account for differential fire effects across forest types. Given the variability in beetle species responses, we recommend a species-specific approach when assessing the effects of fire on insect communities.

abstracts.content: Hasło opisuje Sejmową Komisję ds. Służb Specjalnych (SKSS) – stałą komisję sejmową stanowiącą wyspecjalizowany instrument kontroli legislatywy nad służbami specjalnymi w Polsce. Przedstawiono genezę komisji, jej umocowanie w regulaminie Sejmu oraz podstawowe cechy organizacyjne, w tym niewielki skład osobowy, zasadę niejawności posiedzeń oraz wymóg posiadania poświadczenia bezpieczeństwa przez członków. Hasło omawia zakres kompetencji SKSS w trzech obszarach: kontrolnym, kreacyjnym i legislacyjnym, ze szczególnym uwzględnieniem prawa do opiniowania projektów budżetów, dokumentów rządowych, powołań szefów służb oraz dostępu do informacji o działaniach operacyjnych. Opisano również ewolucję zasad wyboru przewodniczącego komisji, w tym historyczną regułę rotacyjności. W haśle wskazano na ograniczony zakres jawności działalności komisji oraz charakter protokołów i sprawozdań jako informacji niejawnych.

The entry describes the Parliamentary Committee for Special Services (SKSS) – a standing parliamentary committee that serves as a specialized instrument of legislative oversight of intelligence services in Poland. It outlines the origins of the committee, its foundation in the Rules of Procedure of the Sejm, and its main organizational features, including its limited membership, the confidentiality of its proceedings, and the requirement that members hold security clearance. The entry presents the scope of SKSS’s responsibilities across three areas: oversight, appointment-related functions, and legislative activity. Particular attention is given to the committee’s powers to issue opinions on agency budgets, government documents, the appointment of agency heads, and access to information on operational activities. The entry also addresses the evolution of rules concerning the selection of the committee’s chair, including the former principle of rotation. The committee’s limited transparency is discussed, along with the classification of its records and reports as confidential, regardless of their content.

results.title: Determinanty funkcjonowania spółdzielczych gospodarstw rolnych w Polsce

abstracts.content: Celem pracy była ocena dochodowości spółdzielczych gospodarstw rolnych w Polsce oraz identyfikacja czynników wpływających na ich funkcjonowanie i trwałość. Analiza została oparta na danych z systemu rachunkowości rolniczej FADN z lat 2012–2017. Porównano wyniki gospodarstw spółdzielczych z indywidualnymi o podobnych cechach ekonomicznych. Pomimo wyższych kosztów produkcji, gospodarstwa spółdzielcze osiągały wyższą produktywność wszystkich czynników produkcji. Przeciętny dochód netto członka gospodarstwa spółdzielczego był o 26,5% wyższy niż rolnika indywidualnego. Największe różnice dochodowe odnotowano w grupie gospodarstw o powierzchni do 25 ha/1AWU, gdzie dochód członka spółdzielni był ponad dwukrotnie wyższy niż rolnika indywidualnego. Zastosowanie modelu logitowego pozwoliło zidentyfikować czynniki ograniczające ryzyko likwidacji gospodarstw spółdzielczych. Największy wpływ miały: wzrost powierzchni gospodarstwa, zwiększenie liczby członków, lepsze wyniki finansowe (wartość dodana brutto na członka) oraz wyższy poziom inwestycji (wartość amortyzacji). Wyniki badań empirycznych zostały potwierdzone przez ankietę wśród kierowników spółdzielni. Najczęściej wskazywanymi zagrożeniami były czynniki pozaekonomiczne, takie jak brak następców czy niekorzystne regulacje prawne.

Impact of pulse electric field on the level of photon emission in selected soft fruits

abstracts.content:
In the food industry around the world, pulse electric field (PEF) is becoming one of
the most popular methods of preserving food products at low temperature. PEF is an excellent
alternative to standard food preservation processes (such as high temperature, changing water
activity or pH, or adding preservatives), because it does not heat the product and does not lose
valuable ingredients, while maintaining the health-promoting nature of food [1]. In turn, healthpromoting ingredients in food show a greater ability to ultimately emit photons. Therefore, the
level of photon emission in selected soft fruits was examined before and after the impact of the
pulse electric field (PEF) on them. The mean values of photons emitted by the product samples
were compared and the standard deviation was analyzed. The analysis of the results showed
slight differences in the number of photons emitted, both between different types of fruit and
between samples of the same fruit (before and after exposure to PEF).

results.title: Banking concentration and its determinants at the regional level during the Spanish developmentalism

journal.title: Revista de Historia Economica - Journal of Iberian and Latin American Economic History

abstracts.content: En 1962 se realizaron cambios significativos en la ley bancaria española para fomentar la competencia en el sector. Este estudio examina su impacto en la concentración bancaria a nivel provincial utilizando datos inéditos que abarcan los balances de los bancos, e incluyendo cajas de ahorros, para el período comprendido entre 1964 y 1975. El cambio legislativo provocó una disminución sustancial en la concentración en la mayoría de las provincias. Se emplean modelos de panel para identificar los determinantes de la concentración bancaria. Mayores niveles de población y de PIB per cápita, conducen a una menor concentración provincial. Además, las provincias con sectores primarios de mayor tamaño muestran concentraciones bancarias más elevadas. La estructura financiera provincial también es relevante, ya que un mayor número de sucursales y sedes por habitante reduce la concentración bancaria. Estos hallazgos ofrecen nuevas perspectivas sobre la relación entre la concentración bancaria y las economías a nivel regional en España.

In 1962, Spain implemented significant banking law changes to boost competition. This study investigates their impact on provincial banking concentration from 1964 to 1975, utilising novel provincial-level private bank balance sheet data and including savings banks. Results show a substantial decline in concentration across most provinces. Panel data models identify the determinants of banking concentration: larger populations and higher gross domestic product per capita correlate with lower concentration, while agrarian-focused provinces exhibit higher concentration. The provincial financial sector’s structure also matters, with a higher number of branches and headquarters per capita associated with reduced banking concentration. These findings refine existing literature and provide new insights into the intricate relationship between banking concentration and regional economies in Spain.

results.title: Komunikacja prośrodowiskowa w mediach społecznościowych : specyfika i ograniczenia konsumentów w jej przyjęciu

abstracts.content: Skuteczna komunikacja prośrodowiskowa pozwala na kształtowanie zielonych zachowań konsumentów, wzmacniając realizację celów zrównoważonego rozwoju. Osiągnięcie tego rezultatu wymaga doboru właściwych treści oraz kanałów dotarcia. Bezsprzecznie jednym z nich są media społecznościowe umożliwiające interaktywny dialog pomiędzy przedsiębiorstwami a konsumentami. Mimo że kanał ten, ze względu na swoje cechy, jest atrakcyjny dla działań komunikacyjnych na rzecz środowiska, to komunikacji prośrodowiskowej w mediach społecznościowych nie poświęcano dotychczas wiele uwagi. W rozdziale przedyskutowano specyfikę i podstawowe formy komunikacji prośrodowiskowej w mediach społecznościowych, koncentrując się zwłaszcza na czynnikach ograniczających jej skuteczność, między innymi takich jak działania greenwashingowe przedsiębiorstw wywołujące sceptycyzm ze strony konsumentów czy nieumiejętność rozpoznania i oceny deklaracji środowiskowych przez konsumentów. Podkreśla to konieczność opracowywania dobrych praktyk i rekomendacji pozwalających na przezwyciężanie tych ograniczeń.

Effective pro-environmental communication supports the shaping of green consumer behaviours, reinforcing the achievement of sustainable development goals. Achieving this result requires selecting suitable content and channels of communication. Undoubtedly, one of those channels is social media, which enables interactive dialogue between companies and consumers. Although this channel, due to its characteristics, is attractive for environmental communication activities, pro-environmental communication in social media has not received much attention so far. This chapter discusses the specifics and basic forms of pro-environmental communication in social media, focusing in particular on factors limiting its effectiveness, including greenwashing that causes consumers’ scepticism or the inability to recognize and evaluate environmental statements. This requires the development of best practices and recommendations to overcome these limitations.

abstracts.content:

high-speed drive systems.

keywords: Algebraic Modeling of Evolution of System (ALMODES); decision support; simulation model; sustainable development; system dynamics

results.title: Algebraic Modeling of Social Systems Evolution: Application to Sustainable Development Strategy

abstracts.content: This paper presents ALMODES, a discrete-time modeling approach for social systems that uses matrix algebra and directed graphs. The method bridges the gap between static network analysis and continuous System Dynamics, offering a transparent framework that reduces data requirements. The method enables clear causal mapping, rapid simulation, straightforward sensitivity analysis, and natural hybridization with agent-based or discrete-event models. Two case studies illustrate its utility for sustainable-development strategy: in an urban public-health setting, modernization and sanitation policies drive sustained declines in disease despite growth, whereas reversing the population-to-modernization link triggers a morbidity rebound that can be prevented by strengthening the modernization-to-sanitation pathway; in a high-tech services Balanced Scorecard model, a baseline backlog spike depresses customer satisfaction, aggressive hiring shortens the spike but erodes income, and coordinated boosts to training and incentives (about twelve percent productivity gain) remove the backlog early, stabilize customers, and improve income, highlighting human-capital policy as a robust lever. ALMODES thus supports pragmatic policy design under limited, expert-elicited parameters. Future research will address uncertainty quantification, time-varying structures and shocks, automated calibration and empirical validation at scale, optimization and control design, richer integration with hybrid simulation, participatory interfaces for stakeholders, and standardized benchmarks across domains.

Narrations of the city’s public spaces

abstracts.content: Narrative in architecture is investigated increasingly often. The 21st-century’s direct linking of architectural narratives with the urban space and the perceptions of its users, which influences the popularity of this space, is a research gap. This paper presents an original method for analysing spatial narratives in public urban interiors and demonstrates that architectural narrative is an important element of urban space. The comparative case study of Prague and Kraków examples is descriptive and contributes unique insights into the ‘storytelling’ of urban space. Five cases in Prague, Czech Republic, and Kraków, Poland, were studied using a mixed methods approach, combining spatial and functional analysis with literature and media queries, behavioural mapping, and Space Syntax, and then compared with each other in their respective categories, where applicable: Mariánské náměstí against Mały Rynek, the Holešovice Brewery against the Lubicz Brewery, and Lennon’s Wall. In the study, the narrative potential of the spaces investigated is linked to social potential (against exclusion), functional flexibility, and the characteristics of a sustainable urban environment. The analyses identified the following architectural narrative types: historical, contemporary, tropes, costume, and informal. The method has application potential, but it can be further enhanced with questionnaires about the users’ perceptions of space.
